Comment: Sthyra CRM capture pipeline: decode → sfm → mesh → segment → align. The 5 stages mirror ./state-machine.ts STAGES_IN_ORDER. Every stage has retry (3 attempts, exponential backoff) + Catch (DLQ on States.ALL). Phase 1 MVP: all stages are local stubs. Phase 1.b: replace Task resources with real Step Functions tasks invoking Lambda / Fargate.

decode.Comment: Demux 360° mp4 → per-frame images. Real impl: AWS Batch job with ffmpeg. MVP stub: ./stages/decode.ts.

sfm.Comment: Structure-from-motion: COLMAP / GLOMAP. Real impl: GPU job on Fargate. MVP stub: ./stages/sfm.ts.

mesh.Comment: Dense reconstruction → textured mesh. Real impl: OpenMVS / RealityCapture. MVP stub: ./stages/mesh.ts.

segment.Comment: Semantic segmentation of the mesh (walls, doors, fixtures). Real impl: ML inference endpoint. MVP stub: ./stages/segment.ts.

align.Comment: ICP / point-to-plane alignment to BIM model if available. Real impl: PCL/Open3D. MVP stub: ./stages/align.ts.

DlqState.Comment: Terminal failure state. The state machine catches this in ./dlq.ts and emits a structured log + SQS DLQ entry.
DlqState.Cause: Pipeline execution failed after retries exhausted. See context.error for the originating stage and error message.
